description: This file defines classes and functions for managing logical volume data and commands in a kickstart installation context, including various RHEL and Fedora versions.

classes.name: FC3_LogVolData
classes.description: Data class representing a logical volume in FC3 and later versions, with methods for argument string generation.

classes.name: FC4_LogVolData
classes.description: Extended data class for FC4 with additional inode and filesystem options.

classes.name: RHEL5_LogVolData
classes.description: Data class for RHEL5 with encryption options.

classes.name: F9_LogVolData
classes.description: Further extended data class with filesystem profile and encryption options.

classes.name: F12_LogVolData
classes.description: Includes escrow certificate and backup passphrase options.

classes.name: RHEL6_LogVolData
classes.description: Supports encryption, hibernation, thin pools, and profile options.

classes.name: F14_LogVolData
classes.description: Inherits from F12_LogVolData, no additional attributes.

classes.name: F15_LogVolData
classes.description: Adds label attribute for filesystem labeling.

classes.name: F17_LogVolData
classes.description: Adds resize attribute for volume resizing.

classes.name: F18_LogVolData
classes.description: Includes hibernation and cipher options.

classes.name: F20_LogVolData
classes.description: Supports thin pool and volume creation options.

classes.name: F21_LogVolData
classes.description: Adds profile attribute for profiles.

classes.name: F23_LogVolData
classes.description: Includes cache options for performance tuning.

classes.name: F29_LogVolData
classes.description: Supports LUKS encryption parameters.

classes.name: FC3_LogVol
classes.description: Represents a logical volume command for FC3, with argument parsing and string representation.

classes.name: FC4_LogVol
classes.description: Extended command class with additional filesystem options.

classes.name: RHEL5_LogVol
classes.description: Adds encryption options to FC4 command.

classes.name: F9_LogVol
classes.description: Adds filesystem profile and encryption options.

classes.name: F12_LogVol
classes.description: Includes escrow and backup passphrase options.

classes.name: RHEL6_LogVol
classes.description: Supports thin pools, encryption, hibernation, and profile options with validation.

classes.name: F14_LogVol
classes.description: Inherits from F12_LogVol, removes inode argument.

classes.name: F15_LogVol
classes.description: Adds label attribute for filesystem labeling.

classes.name: F17_LogVol
classes.description: Includes resize option for volume resizing.

classes.name: F18_LogVol
classes.description: Supports hibernation and cipher options.

classes.name: F20_LogVol
classes.description: Supports thin pool and volume creation options.

classes.name: F21_LogVol
classes.description: Adds profile attribute for profiles.

classes.name: RHEL7_LogVol
classes.description: Adds mkfs options and validation for filesystem parameters.

classes.name: F23_LogVol
classes.description: Includes cache configuration options.

classes.name: F29_LogVol
classes.description: Supports advanced encryption parameters.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes data classes and command classes with attributes and options.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates argument parser for the command, adding relevant options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments, performs validation, and returns data objects.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of logical volume data objects.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Returns the class used for data objects.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the logical volume data.
